name: Brainwaves - Memory Influx
source:
A puzzle visual novel style game where a detective must solve a murder but his haunted past may get in his way.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/brainwaves-0]Global Game Jam[/url]]

Created for Global Game Jam 2017.
translation:
一部解谜视觉小说风格的游戏，讲述侦探必须解决谋杀案，却可能受到自己缠绕不去的过去阻碍。

为2017年Global Game Jam制作。

（来源：[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/brainwaves-0]Global Game Jam[/url]）
